continue_criteria: all actual queries have matching before/after input identities and bytes
all original resets/wait/step/policy calls, hashes, action chunks and selected checkpoint identities unchanged by recorder except declared timing perturbation
recorded execution counts and all58 original trial statuses pass; zero dropped failures, zero retries
root and independent terminal evidence audit including complete Slurm cost
gate_rules: For A before first predict: persist five original component bytes/dtype/shape and instruction UTF-8 identity; store by complete state identity, excluding method.

For B before first predict: persist its inputs, compare all five components byte-for-byte plus instruction; mismatch halts before B predict. A ledger remains and B start is retained, with explicit incomplete attempt sidecar.
All queries: persist before/after raw components and enforce observation object identity/bytes unchanged at boundaries.
Returned original action chunks are copied to sidecar. Executed controls are logged after the unchanged env.step and increment; observer never clips/reorders/overrides them.
Original policy Exception is retained as original policy_error row; gate halts at trial_end, so formal_trials cannot proceed to the next trial.

Gate failures use BaseException outside original Exception-only catches, close env in original finally, restore code bindings and emit outer failure/partial receipt. No fake completed result is synthesized.
interpretation_limits: A passing new engineering attempt does not identify or repair the old mismatch.
Historical before-query arrays are unavailable; changed old histories cannot be reconstructed by this gate.
Boundary equality cannot detect a mutation reverted before return or invisible simulator/GPU state.
Copies and disk writes perturb wall time and potentially realized execution scheduling; these are not full O2A or component latency samples.
No automatic acceptance/replacement of old200 or launch of new Goal science follows a pass; require explicit typed invalid-attempt lineage and separate source/consumer/runtime admission.
prerequisites: independent audit of candidate source, full AST hooks, exact original-call projection, CPU evidence and fail-stop/partial-record contract
root integration into fresh bounded engineering package, full existing action/assets/source/manifest/checkpoint guards retained
new package and config hashes bound to precise P prepare/verify proof and independent review
root unique one-shot registration, writer lock/CAS, capacity reservation and no duplicate or ambiguous pending submit
purpose: Validate that a new attempt has equal method-independent before-policy t0 inputs and that inference preserves current inputs; never diagnose the missing historical bytes by assumption.
scope: Same immutable original first58 identities,29 existing development states, state-major A then B; no state/result selection. Re-execution does not claim identical prior realized history.
stop_criteria: any identity/source/config/checkpoint drift or unproven wrapper binding
any prequery t0 mismatch, postquery input mutation, missing capture, changed observer RNG/sim/input, I/O failure or duplicate trial
any policy/environment/cleanup error; FAILED/TIMEOUT/PREEMPTED/unknown state; no auto retry
partial or unverifiable ledger/capture; preserve all partial evidence and costs
